## Summary

The business-day rule for the registration date now extends to public holidays.

**Change:** `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/RegistrationDates.java`

`toBusinessDay` previously rolled a date forward only over Saturday/Sunday. I added the fixed public-holiday set (`2026-01-01`, `2026-01-26`, `2026-04-25`, `2026-12-25`, `2026-12-28`) and extended the roll-forward loop so that when the adjusted date lands on a weekend **or** a listed holiday it advances one day at a time until it reaches the next non-holiday business day. Because the loop re-checks every condition each iteration, a holiday that falls on (or rolls onto) a weekend, or consecutive holidays like 12-25/12-28, are all skipped correctly. The class Javadoc was updated to match.

This mirrors the test's own `toBusinessDay`/`HOLIDAYS` ground truth in `AcceptanceBase.java`. The suite passes: **Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0 — BUILD SUCCESS**.
